# Civil Rights Cold Case Records Review Board

> > Official repository of declassified federal records documenting unsolved civil rights era murders, lynchings, and racial violence cases from 1940-1979.

The Civil Rights Cold Case Records Review Board works with the National Archives, FBI, Department of Justice, and other federal agencies to review and release investigative records related to racially motivated homicides. The site provides access to case files involving WWII veterans, NAACP investigations, police shootings, lynchings, and other acts of racial violence primarily in Alabama, North Carolina, and other Southern states.

## Cold Case Records

- [Emmett Till](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/cases/1955-08-28-emmett-till): 1955 Emmett Till lynching case records from Mississippi investigation
- [Henry G. Andrews](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/cases/1947-06-07-henry-g-andrews): 1947 police shooting of WWII veteran Henry G. Andrews in Warren County, NC
- [Rev. Edward Green](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/cases/1943-09-13-rev-edward-green): 1943 lynching of WWII veteran Rev. Edward Green in Elmore County, Alabama
- [Timothy Hood](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/cases/1946-02-08-timothy-hood): 1946 police shooting of Marine veteran Timothy Hood on streetcar, Alabama
- [Willie Ruth Mosley](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/cases/1951-04-28-willie-ruth-mosley): 1951 police shooting of Willie Ruth Mosley in Gadsden, Alabama
- [Isaac J. Mayo](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/cases/1947-08-24-isaac-j-mayo): 1947 death of WWII veteran Isaac J. Mayo in railroad incident, Norlina, NC
- [Aletha Bell Carter](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/cases/1945-08-15-letha-bell-carter): 1945 homicide and sexual assault of Aletha Bell Carter in South Carolina
- [Flam Belle](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/cases/1941-07-29-flam-belle): 1941 prison camp death of Flam Belle in Sparta, Georgia from beating
- [Russell Charley](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/cases/1954-05-08-russell-charley): 1954 lynching of sawmill worker Russell Charley in Vredenburgh, Alabama
- [Edward Green](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/cases/1944-03-13-edward-green): 1944 killing of U.S. Army soldier Edward Green over bus segregation dispute

## News and Announcements

- [Four New WWII Soldier Death Records Released](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/press/2025-04-29-cold-cases-review-board-releases-four-new-sets-of-records-each-involving-the-death-of-a-wwii-era-soldier): Board releases records on four WWII soldier deaths including Thomas Broadus
- [Eleanor Rush Case: 17-Year-Old Found Dead in Cell](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/blog/2026-01-29-latest-records-release-includes-17-year-old-girl-found-dead-after-being-bound-and-gagged-in-her-cell): Eleanor Rush case: 17-year-old found dead in solitary confinement, 1954
- [Student Advocacy Led to Cold Case Legislation](https://www.coldcaserecords.gov/content/blog/2025-05-22-a-class-project-that-took-years-and-ended-up-on-the-presidents-desk): Hightstown High School students' advocacy led to cold case legislation
